text: Arnold Clark, Scotland men's rugby front-of-shirt partner, is Arnold Clark Automobiles Limited (Companies House SC036386). Its active persons with significant control are Clark family members - John Arnold Clark and Lady Philomena Butler Clark each with 75% or more of shares and voting rights with control over the trustees of a trust, Adam Hugh Wallace Clark with 25-50% via trustees - and Jagc Holdings with 25-50%.
short: Arnold Clark is the Clark family's company (Arnold Clark Automobiles Ltd, SC036386).
